newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank to further liberalise forex regime.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank to further liberalise forex regime.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Friday said it had decided to further liberalise the country's foreign exchange regime in relation with OECD guidelines.

"The approved changes to the foreign exchange regime will further liberalise receiving and extending foreign loans, investment abroad and purchase of real estates in relation with the OECD," the NBS said in a statement released after a meeting of its governing board.
It gave no further details and bank officials were not immediately available for comment.
The new measure is to be effective from December 1996, it said.

Under current law, foreign investors are not allowed to buy real estate in Slovakia and any direct foreign loan must be approved by the NBS. The statement did not disclose what changes to the current legislation were approved.
Slovakia has been adjusting its legislation in accordance with OECD standards, as may be invited to join the organisation by the end of 1997.
